name: search_places
description: Search for places by text query. Returns names, addresses, ratings, and a composite score that accounts for both rating and number of reviews (Bayesian average). Results are sorted by score. Include score when mentioning ratings to the user

query.description: Search query, e.g. 'pizza near Times Square' or 'pharmacies in Berlin'.

min_rating.description: Minimum rating filter (1.0 to 4.5, in 0.5 increments). Optional.

open_now.description: Only return places that are currently open. Optional.
